scenes.narration: Being left out can look, in the brain, a lot like physical pain.
scenes.main_point: Show a character standing apart while two others toss a ball over their head, so the feeling of being left out is seen
scenes.visual_objective: Show a character standing apart while two others toss a ball over their head, so the feeling of being left out is seen

scenes.narration: In one study, people played a virtual ball game and were left out.
scenes.main_point: Show the virtual ball game: two avatars pass to each other and never to the third, with the character watching
scenes.visual_objective: Show the virtual ball game: two avatars pass to each other and never to the third, with the character watching

scenes.narration: The more distress they reported, the more active the anterior cingulate was.
scenes.main_point: Show distress building as a tangle inside the head, with two restrained bars rising together
scenes.visual_objective: Show distress building as a tangle inside the head, with two restrained bars rising together

scenes.narration: Another region was active, and linked to less distress.
scenes.main_point: Show the tangle loosening while a soft ring forms, for the region linked to less distress
scenes.visual_objective: Show the tangle loosening while a soft ring forms, for the region linked to less distress

scenes.narration: That sting comes with measurable brain activity.
scenes.main_point: Show another character sitting beside, the light warming and the heart mending, as the feeling is named
scenes.visual_objective: Show another character sitting beside, the light warming and the heart mending, as the feeling is named
